description:
PROBLEM: the PreToolUse author-field audit hook (.claude/hooks/pretooluse-author-field-audit.sh) HARD-BLOCKS a commit whenever it matches an author-like field (incl. publisher:), with no sanctioned reviewed-allow path. Legitimate NON-authorship uses of those field names get blocked; the only escapes are a wrong-edit (false attribution) or narrowing/deferring the commit.

EVIDENCE (origindex-box arc, 2026-06-14, two distinct incidents):
1. publisher: CalGEM / CDFW-OSPR / NOAA-USCG / USCG in dataset-explainer skill frontmatter + research/design docs -- legitimate DATA-SOURCE citations (who publishes the cited dataset); author: was correctly Denson Smith throughout. Blocked the baseline commit.
2. VERA + CATO verdict .md whose authorship-AUDIT prose quotes 'Author: Denson Smith (throttle.py ...)' and 'provider.organization = Denson Smith' -- i.e. the verdicts AFFIRMING correct authorship tripped the gate. These remain UNCOMMITTED (preserved on-disk, excluded) pending this fix.

IMPACT: blocks legitimate commits; forces a FALSE edit (publisher:->Denson Smith would be false attribution) or narrowing/deferring; currently keeps immutable verification records (VERA/CATO verdicts) out of git.

LOCATION: .claude/hooks/pretooluse-author-field-audit.sh (deployed substrate; consumer workspaces inherit it).

GAP (problem, not prescription -- the substrate team owns the fix): no way to distinguish/allow a reviewed legitimate use (source-CITATION fields like publisher/source/provider, or audit-prose that affirms correct authorship) from an actual false-attribution. The flag itself is correct and wanted; the missing piece is a reviewed-allow path so legitimate uses are not hard-blocked. Filed by user-tier POLYBIUS-A2A on PRINCIPAL's instruction; origindex carries a user-tier Option-A ruling on incident 1 for reference.
title: author-field gate hard-blocks legitimate source-citation + audit-prose fields (no reviewed-allow path)
